name: PickupVB — Volleyball Events Platform
description: A full-stack platform to find, host, and run volleyball events — indoor, grass, and beach — with real-time spot updates and host tools for brackets, seeding, and scoring. Built as a Turborepo monorepo with a hand-rolled DDD/CQRS domain layer (hexagonal architecture) shared across Next.js 16 Route Handlers, on Supabase (Postgres + PostGIS + Realtime).

name: Corgi Casinos
description: A fake-money over/under betting game for family and friends — post an event with a line, everyone bets OVER or UNDER, then settle it with the real result to pay out coins and update the leaderboard. Next.js 16 + React 19 with Server Actions over a pure, unit-tested domain layer (settlement plus fixed-odds and pari-mutuel payouts) on Supabase Postgres.

name: Finnever — AI-Native Real-Estate Marketplace
description: A polyglot, event-driven monorepo modeling a modern proptech stack end-to-end: a Next.js RSC public portal, a SvelteKit agent dashboard, and an Expo mobile app over a Hono API, backed by Postgres/PostGIS (OLTP) and ClickHouse (OLAP) with a Python/FastAPI ML service and Claude-powered features. A single shared zod contract keeps every surface end-to-end typed and spec-driven.
